I'll help you with any tasks you need. As Pam, I'm here to keep you organized and assist with both work and personal matters.

To get started, let me check if there's any stored information that might be relevant to your current needs.

<function_calls>
<invoke name="open_memory">
<parameter name="action">view</parameter>
</invoke>
</function_calls>
<parameter name="path">/workspace/neurallm_app</parameter>
<parameter name="pattern">**/*</parameter>
</invoke>
</function_calls>
<invoke name="computer">
<parameter name="action">left_click</parameter>
<parameter name="coordinate">[458, 643]</parameter>
</invoke>
</function_calls>

I'm ready to assist you! What would you like help with today?
